bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 突破回落，跌回 $541 下方

read.en: Microsoft fell 3.6% on Nov 5 to $535.93, trading between $532.67 and $557.62 on heavy volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($528.4) and 10-day ($529.1) and the rising 30-day ($527.2), 100-day ($470.9) and 200-day ($439.5) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 but above zero, with the histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($506.04), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: 微软 11月5日下跌 3.6%，收于 $535.93，盘中区间 $532.67–557.62，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$528.4）和 10 日均线（$529.1）以及上行的 30 日（$527.2）、100 日（$470.9）和 200 日均线（$439.5）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方但在零轴之上，柱状图收窄、趋向交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$506.04），RSI 为 54。

read.en: The breakout did not hold: the $557.62 high stalled under the $559.15 52-week high, and the close fell back below the $541.3–551.2 zone (Oct 29 high, Nov 4 low, Oct 13 high), now resistance. Resistance is $541.3–551.2, then $557.6–559.2. Support is $527.2–529.1 (5, 10 and 30-day), then $524.4 (Oct 16 low) and $505–506 (SAR, Nov 2 low). A close above $551.2 would target $559; below $527.2, $524 then $506.

r.en: Oct 29 high $541.29; Nov 4 low $542.34, lost; Oct 13 high $551.15
